title: Pure Six Samurai
summary: The modern Six Samurai Synchro build with generic staples. The Legendary Six Samurai swarm the field: Kageki brings out a second Samurai from the hand, and Kizan summons itself next to a Samurai with a different name. The 2024-25 Tuners and Synchros lead. Anarchist Monk and Tactical Trainer summon themselves next to a Samurai and, once they leave the field, search a Six Samurai Quick-Play Spell or a Six Strike card. They tune into the Legendary Lord Six Samurai. Shi En searches a Samurai and negates a monster effect, Enishi bounces monsters, and Kizan, the newest card, banishes a Six Strike card to destroy a card on the opponent's turn and revives itself. Six Strike - Sextuple Barrage wipes their field with three Six Samurai Synchros out. Gateway of the Six is Limited.
main: Legendary Six Samurai - Kageki
Normal Summoned: summons a Level 4 or lower Six Samurai from the hand.
Legendary Six Samurai - Kizan
Summons itself next to a Six Samurai with a different name.
Anarchist Monk of the Six Samurai
Tuner: summons itself; leaving the field, searches a Six Samurai Quick-Play Spell.
Tactical Trainer of the Six Samurai
Tuner: summons itself; leaving the field, searches a Six Strike card.
Legendary Six Samurai - Enishi
Banishes two Samurai from the GY to bounce a monster on either turn.
Legendary Six Samurai - Mizuho
Tributes a Samurai to destroy a card.
Legendary Six Samurai - Shinai
Summons itself with Mizuho; tributed, recovers a Samurai.
Kagemusha of the Six Samurai
Tuner: redirects a targeting effect onto itself.
Shien's Smoke Signal
Searches a Level 3 or lower Six Samurai, including both new Tuners.
Six Strike - Double Assault
Quick-Play: summons a Samurai and flips their monster face-down; recovers a Samurai.
Gateway of the Six
Limited. Bushido Counters on every Samurai summon; searches and pumps.
Asceticism of the Six Samurai
Quick-Play: summons a Samurai with the same ATK, such as Tactical Trainer for Kageki.
Six Strike - Triple Impact
With three Samurai out, wipes their monsters or Spells/Traps.
Six Strike - Sextuple Barrage
Newest Trap: with three Six Samurai Synchros, destroys all their cards.
extra: Legendary Lord Six Samurai - Shi En
Level 6 Synchro: searches a Samurai and negates a monster effect.
Newest Level 6 Synchro: destroys a card on their turn; revives itself.
Level 6 Synchro: bounces their monsters for each banished Samurai.
Battle Shogun of the Six Samurai
Link-2: searches a card that places Bushido Counters.
Shadow of the Six Samurai - Shien
Rank 4 Six Samurai: sets a Samurai's ATK to 2000.
